notes: Run sh codex/evals/prepare.sh hobin-skill-eval commit-message-evals first, from the repository root, with HOBIN_AGENT_ROOT set to it; pass -m to choose the model.

scenarios.title: commit-message-evals
scenarios.userInput: $hobin-skill-eval:evaluating-skills Build evals for the skill in skills/commit-message so I can tell whether it's worth keeping. Put them under evals/commit-message/. Don't run any models yet, just build the eval set. Then write `REPORT.md` in the repository root saying what the results will be compared against and how they decide what happens to the skill.
